title: Elephant: the eye blocks, and the river confines
rationale: The elephant on c5 has four two-step diagonals. a3 is blocked by the soldier on its eye at b4; a7 and e7 are across the river, which the elephant never crosses however empty its eye is; e3 alone survives both rules. The two are separate: one is an occupancy question and the other a region the piece may never leave.
